newsitem.title: USA: Dlr off at US open, mark up on Chirac announcement.
newsitem.headline: Dlr off at US open, mark up on Chirac announcement.

text.p: The dollar opened weaker as market players scooped up marks following French President Jacques Chirac's decision to call a snap parliamentary election, currency experts said.
On Monday, Chirac launched the procedure for calling an election nine months early and his office announced he would make a television and radio address at 1600 EDT/2000 GMT.

In a general election, the socialist party could gain some seats, potentially hurting France's bid to join in European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), said Takanobu Igarashi, a senior economist at Sanwa Bank Ltd in New York.
